pa001.e: そうじする = きれいに する (to clean).

pa002.e: しょくじを する (in the evening) = ばんごはんを たべる.
pa002.t: I have dinner at 8 every night.

pa003.e: くらい = あかるく ない (dark).

pa004.e: やすく ない = たかい (expensive).

pa005.e: A lends to B = B borrows from A (かりる).

pa006.e: A gives me (くれる) = I receive from A (もらう).
pa006.t: My mother gave me a sweater.

pa007.e: おととい = two days ago (ふつかまえ).
pa007.t: I met a friend the day before yesterday.

pa008.e: あさって = the day after tomorrow (in two days).
pa008.t: I have a test the day after tomorrow.

pa009.e: おもしろく ない = つまらない (boring).

pa010.e: へた = じょうずじゃ ない.

pa011.e: せまい = ひろく ない (small, cramped).

pa012.e: けさ = きょうの あさ (this morning).

pa013.e: こんばん = きょうの よる (tonight).

pa014.e: ゆうべ = きのうの よる (last night).
pa014.t: I went to bed late last night.

pa015.e: からだが じょうぶ: to be healthy, rarely get sick.
pa015.t: My older brother is in good health.

pa016.e: At the post office you buy stamps (きって).

pa017.e: At the library you borrow books.

pa018.e: にぎやか: lively, full of people.

pa019.e: 〜に つとめる = 〜で はたらく (to work at).
pa019.t: My older sister works at a bank.

pa020.e: すきじゃ ない ≈ きらい.

pa021.e: やさしい (for a problem) = かんたん (easy).

pa022.e: A teaches me = I learn from A (ならう).

pa023.e: さんぽ = a stroll, walking a little.
pa023.t: I take a walk every morning.

pa024.e: さむく ない ≈ あたたかい.

pa025.e: ひろく ない = せまい.

pa026.e: でかけて いる: has gone out, isn't home.
pa026.t: My father is out right now.

pa027.e: めがねを かける = めがねを する (to wear glasses).

pa028.e: おくれる: to be late, be delayed.

pa030.e: とおく ない = ちかい.
pa030.t: My house isn't far from the station.

pa031.e: おじ: uncle (father's or mother's brother).
pa031.t: This is a photo of my uncle.

pa032.t: This is a photo of my grandmother.

pa033.e: ちいさい = おおきく ない.

pa034.e: がっこうを やすむ = not going to school.
pa034.t: Yuki was absent from school today.

pa036.e: しって いる ≈ to have heard / to know.
pa036.t: Do you know about that news?

pa038.e: いい てんき = はれ (clear, sunny).

pa039.e: はを みがく: to brush your teeth, with a toothbrush (はブラシ).
pa039.t: I brush my teeth every day.

pa041.t: Please finish this work by 3 o'clock.

pa042.e: ひとりで すむ: to live alone.

pa043.e: (In a restaurant) たのむ = ちゅうもんする (to order).

pa044.e: たかく ない = やすい.

pa045.e: Homework first, then going out: 〜て から.
pa045.t: I did my homework before leaving the house.

pa046.e: きたない = きれいじゃ ない (dirty).

pa047.e: スポーツ ≈ うんどう (exercise).

pa048.e: おおぜい = たくさん (for people).
pa048.t: There are lots of children in the park.

pa050.e: あさって = in two days.
pa050.t: The summer holidays start the day after tomorrow.

pa051.t: Yesterday I went to bed at 9 and got up at 6.

pa053.e: しまる: to close. Open until 9.

pa054.e: かぜを ひく: to catch a cold; びょういんへ いく ≈ いしゃに みて もらう.
pa054.t: I caught a cold and went to the hospital.

pa055.e: たんじょうび: birthday, the day you were born.

pa056.e: つまらない = おもしろく ない.

pa057.t: My younger sister is 8 years old now.

pa058.e: 〜ないで ください ≈ 〜ては いけません (not allowed).

pa059.e: Never seen it = not even once yet.
pa059.t: I have never seen this movie.

pa060.e: No siblings = ひとりっこ (only child).
pa060.t: I don't have any brothers or sisters.

pa061.e: せんしゅう: last week (about 7 days ago).
pa061.t: I bought this book last week.

pa062.e: りょこう: traveling to various places.

pa064.e: やすみ: day off, no work.

pa065.e: ぎゅうにゅう = ミルク (milk).

pa066.e: うるさい = しずかじゃ ない (noisy).
pa066.t: The room next door is noisy.

pa067.e: For the first time = never before.
pa067.t: Yesterday I ate sushi for the first time.

pa068.e: Tricky one (N4): つかいにくい = hard to use.
pa068.t: This pen is hard to use.

pa069.e: Studies at university = is a university student.

pa070.e: あるいて ２０ぷん: 20 minutes on foot.
pa070.t: It's a 20-minute walk to the office.

pa071.e: On a trip = not at home.
pa071.t: My older brother is on a trip right now.

pa072.t: This shop opens at 10 in the morning.

pa073.e: Had a headache = was feeling unwell.

pa074.e: いえを でる = でかける.

pa075.e: しんせつ ≈ やさしい.

pa076.t: I sleep seven hours every day.

pa077.e: しょくどう: dining hall, cafeteria.

pa078.e: かんたん = むずかしく ない.

pa079.e: Tricky one: if it snows, it will be cold.

pa080.t: Ms. Tanaka is Mr. Sato's wife.

pa081.e: Teaches me = I learn from her.
pa081.t: Ms. Lee is my class's teacher.

pa082.e: Long = it took a lot of time.

pa084.e: The clothes have become too small.
pa084.t: These clothes have gotten too small.

pa085.t: My mother gets up at 6 every morning.

pa086.e: Dislikes it → doesn't eat it much.

pa087.e: さむい = あたたかく ない.

pa088.t: Yamada is not at home right now.

pa089.t: A bank has opened in front of the station.
